workload: Hellinger fidelity to the exact ideal distribution (Aer statevector). QPUTwin: its own compiler (SABRE seed 0 on lattices), calibrated noise on the density-matrix engine, with and without idle-window decoherence. Aer-matched: QPUTwin's identical compiled circuit (same gates, same physical qubits, asserted equal to the worker's gate histogram), rebuilt with Qiskit gates, with an independently written per-qubit model (noise_models.py: relaxation then depolarising solved to each gate's own fidelity, per-qubit T1/T2 and readout); 100 000 shots each. tvd = total-variation distance between the two noisy distributions. The 2Q columns compare QPUTwin's compiler with Qiskit transpile (optimization_level=1, seed 0)
